plugins.name: giles
plugins.description: Knowledge-base discipline for agent-notes files. Keeps CLAUDE.md as an index not a dump, distinguishes active-work records from post-completion archaeology (adapting to each repo's planning convention), and ships three skills: a one-off cleanup for sprawling agent-notes files, an end-of-session distill for capturing valuable session learnings, and a setup skill that configures routing directives to external knowledge stores.
